name: Bundle segmented tracks by eccentricity - Parcellation (multiple parcellations)
summary: Splits tracts from a white matter classification into sub-bundles by the parcels their streamline endpoints reach in one or more parcellations (for example eccentricity bins), using MRtrix3, and outputs a new classification and tractogram.
description: Extracts each selected tract from the classification, assigns its streamlines to parcels with MRtrix3 tck2connectome, keeps streamlines whose two endpoints fall in parcels with the same base label (left/right prefixes ignored), and rebuilds a classification with one tract per tract/parcel. Multiple input parcellations are binarized and combined into one label image with FSL first, each parcellation becoming one label. Use it to bundle visual tracts such as the optic radiation by eccentricity parcels. The parcellation must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation(s) whose labels define the bins (for example eccentricity parcels), with label.json.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) indexing the tractogram.

outputs.description: New classification with one tract per selected input tract and parcel (named <tract>_<parcel>), with tract JSON files and fiber counts.
